author: Cyclops
body:
Although "bumping" topics are frowned upon here, but there is something wrong with this that I want to address, and maybe the staff may want to follow this?

Topic bumping shouldn't count if one is giving positive feedback towards an old topic.. unless you wanna see the same thread being created every few months over and over... It should only count if a player bumps a topic for no apparent reason whatsoever.
Also, we shouldn't lock the topic right off the bat if a player bumps an old topic for no apparent reason, maybe a warning and archive the post. Once it gets out of hand, a forum ban should be considered.

Only problem with this is there may not be a Senior Mod online at the current time something like this is happening.

+1???

replies.body:
+1, it's really not fair to the topic creator if the topic gets locked just because one person bumped it.

This should also be the same for flamewars, just archive all the flame stuff and warn the people who flamed and/or forum (temp)ban them.
